explanation: Avocados do not ripen on the tree, so growers can leave mature fruit hanging for months as natural storage and pick them as needed.

claims.text: Guacamole is made by mashing avocados.
Guacamole is not made by mashing mango, papaya or guava.
Avocados do not ripen while attached to the tree; they ripen after being picked.
Growers can leave mature avocados on the tree for months and harvest them when needed.
